name: Colorado Contract Cut & Sew
old_description: We die-cut for all types of fabric and foam as well as bias and straight cutting and binding.
about:
Colorado Contract Cut & Sew operates from Denver, Colorado, where it was founded in 1989 as a family-owned and operated contract cut-and-sew business. The company has remained under family ownership for over 35 years, building a reputation for reliability, quality, and collaborative service.

The facility provides die-cutting for all types of fabric and foam, bias and straight cutting, binding, and a range of sewing services including coverstitch, heat-seal label pressing, and automatic snap attachment. Equipment includes an Automatic Servo Cutting Table with Spreader, coverstitch machines with three needles, and modular die-cutting systems for label changes and clip tabs. The shop also offers pattern making, product design, prototyping, sample runs, and quick-turn short-run manufacturing without large minimum-order requirements.

The company serves diverse corporate markets, working with brands that need production-ready cut-and-sew components. While specific customer names are not disclosed, the service lineup indicates clients in apparel, soft goods, and labeled products requiring precision fabric and foam cutting.

Colorado Contract Cut & Sew emphasizes a collaborative process between its team and the customer, focusing on consistent quality, efficient production, and minimal material waste through automatic precision knife cutting technology.
